data.narrative:
Critical Loop is a Series A climate and energy company founded by Bala Ramamurthy that has raised $49M to date. The broader Climate & Energy sector comprises nine peer companies, including private-stage peers such as Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen, alongside one public comparable (LNZA).

Given the absence of sufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage peers in the narrow Climate & Energy space—no more than three datapoints aligned on stage and valuation tier—peer-median triangulation is not applicable. The primary analytical method deployed is stage-progression, which applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A advancement to the $49M total raised proxy, yielding an implied valuation of $98M. This single-method result establishes the median point for the range.

The triangulation range spans $83M (low) to $113M (high), with $98M as the central estimate. The analysis rests heavily on the stage-progression assumption: the 2.0x multiplier reflects early-stage progression norms but depends critically on Critical Loop's operational milestones, capital efficiency, and sector-specific deployment risk, none of which are quantified in available data. The inability to anchor against peer comps introduces material uncertainty; investors should supplement this valuation with diligence on unit economics and technology maturity relative to the identified peer set.
